answer: The fable that fakes cost nothing dies here. Every newcomer posts a $30 escrow bond on a public referral graph, sponsor named. Any peer may challenge one; a proven fake loses its bond to the challenger, and its sponsor pays the same fine. An island of aliases under one sponsor is flagged fast, star clusters stand out. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000, while an honest agent pays $30 once and keeps a pearl of record that earns steady work.
